title: VaultMT
description: VaultMT is a lightweight, modern API for managing economies on Minecraft servers (Paper/Folia), built upon a flexible provider architecture.
body:
**VaultMT is a next-generation solution for servers that require a reliable, fast, and scalable economy. Moving beyond monolithic, rigid systems, we offer a modular approach: simply plug in the best data storage method for your needs, while administrators gain complete control via a user-friendly `config.yml` configuration file.**
Why VaultMT?

- High Performance: Optimized to run on the latest versions of Java. No "heavy" processes to burden your server resources.

- Bridge Architecture: A unique provider system. This allows VaultMT to operate either autonomously or—when necessary—in conjunction with other networks.

- Flexible Configuration: Customize everything—from currency symbols to auto-save intervals.

Key Features

- ✅ Automation: The system automatically selects the optimal economy provider for your setup.

- ✅ Lightweight: A minimal-footprint plugin with virtually zero impact on your server's TPS.

- ✅ For Developers: A clean API designed for seamless integration with your other plugins and bots.

- ✅ Full Folia Support: Optimized for multi-threaded environments.

- ✅ Hybrid (Bridge) Architecture: Automatically detects the presence of other economy plugins (e.g., EssentialsX), seamlessly switching to its own built-in autonomous system if none are found.
